paragraphs.text: Peter , the Wolf Knight , is a Human woodsman from Eldraine and Ruby 's brother who was enchanted by Agatha .
Peter is a woodsman, considered the best hunter in Edgewall. His beard is thick and his hair unkempt, yet his eyes are kind, and his smile warm. He knows some amount of herblore.
Peter is a subversion of the huntsman from " Little Red Riding Hood ," being himself turned into the wolf rather than saving Riding Hood. His name is a reference to Peter and the Wolf .

Peter raised Ruby in a cabin on the edge of Edgewall Keep on his own, implying their parents may be deceased. While out hunting, he was enchanted by Agatha . Donning a wolf helmet, mail, and a blood red gambeson, he became a fearsome knight who carried a bow and a longsword. He and Agatha captured Imodane before he ran into Kellan and Ruby. After he fought off a pack of Witchstalkers , the enchantment was broken when Kellan killed Agatha. Due to his injuries, he did not accompany Kellan further on his quest.
